column1: Supplementary Table 1. Conditionally independent genome wide significant variants. Here we present the results for our 197 sentinel variants that are genome-wide significant (P<8.31x10-9) in the exact joint conditional model (estimates shown as 'Ejoint'). Variants which were genome-wide significant in the unconditional GWAS analysis that did not survive in the exact joint conditional model are not shown. Also shown are the unconditional beta and pvalue estimates from the GWAS. Novel/known locus indicates a novel or known hit based on a 1MB region around the sentinel, 'A1' is the effect allele, 'A2' the other allele and 'N_imp' is the sample size multiplied by the imputation quality to indicate approximate sample size for the test. 'MR' indicates whether the variant was included in our pleiotropic, LD pruned instrument for Mendelian randomisation. A locus number is given to allow ease of navigation between tables. Gene name designations for loci are based on cadidate or nearest gene. Known loci are named as previosuly designated for consistency. Analysis within European ancestry date are shown as Euro Beta and Euro Pvalue. Data for the HBB locus is shown for completeness but was seen to be the result of a technical artefact. *rs334 Euro MAF was <0.1% so would be excluded from the GWAS but is shown for comparison.
